method: Actual app/core/menu-scroll scripts with DOM event simulation. Physical pointer deltas are mapped for all four display modes; firing is verified with real ammunition consumption. Additional integrated cases model capture/target/bubble and implicit capture transfer. This is not browser/device validation.
